name: Find Skills
description: Help users discover and install skills when they ask how to do something that might have an available skill.

promptPatterns: \b(find.*skill|找.*技能|有没有.*技能|is there a skill)\b

commands.description: Discover available skills for a task
commands.injectPrompt: Apply the find-skills skill: search the installed skill registry and the skill marketplace index for skills matching the user's need, present matches with descriptions, and offer to install/enable them.
